summary: Python bridge materializes one declared future RED test without starting Quick Dev; supports W0-W6 fixed templates with TWR identifiers; reads implementation-contract.v1.json and requires known slice_id; selector comes from tdd.red.test_selector before ::; selector must be in planned_new_files and allowed_changes.tests; snapshot_paths must equal the single selector; plan must resolve under repository_root/execution-plans; target must be relative, remain inside repository root, and exclude logs/execution-plans path parts; existing identical target is accepted, conflicting content is rejected; missing target directories/file are created UTF-8 with LF; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, slice-id, snapshot-path, and --materialize-only; success emits materialized status, slice ID, POSIX target path, and empty authorizations; templates probe typed selection identity, stale transport continuation, coverage gaps, three-gate projection, current-pointer integrity, retention approval, and end-to-end migration; ambiguity: W2 name mentions conflicting overlap but template only tests a gap
